welcome.title: Thank you for trying Rewound
body: Thank you so much for trying out our new platform, Rewound.

This is the app and website for you to try and test out. We've provided a dummy credit card so you can create an account, buy watches, and use every feature. As you're playing around with it we would love to get your feedback on the clearness of the message, the features, any questions, or anything else — the more genuine the feedback, the better.

Anywhere we ask you to fill something in — signing up, your address, listing a watch — there's a button that fills it in for you, so you never have to make up a phone number or an address to keep going. Use your own details instead any time you'd rather.
To give feedback on the site, click the beta bar at the top of the page. In the app, take a screenshot, tap the screenshot, press the checkmark, and an option to provide beta feedback will show up.
Any feedback that could help us improve would be awesome.
